data.case_title: Guardianship proceedings for mother – hearing of son (Betreuungsgericht)
data.summary: The Betreuungsgericht (guardianship court) at Amtsgericht Musterwernigerode is handling a case about appointing a legal guardian (Betreuer) for the recipient's mother, Gertrud Beispielharz, and wants to hear the son's view at a hearing on 21 January 2027 at 1:30 pm in the nursing home "Am Brockenblick", room 12.
data.explanation: The court is deciding whether your mother needs a legal guardian and wants your opinion as her son. Attending the hearing is encouraged but not legally required; if you cannot come, you may send your views in writing instead. There is no formal penalty for not attending, but the court may decide without your input if you say nothing. The letter also mentions an unrelated, optional information evening about the court's new online services on 28 January 2027, which needs no registration.
